idea-plugin.name: TCalc
idea-plugin.description:
TCalc

Local-first workspace token calculator, model recommender, and coding-agent optimizer.

Scan your workspace, estimate token usage, compare AI coding models, generate repo maps, and create agent rules — all on your machine with no telemetry and no cloud calls.

Local-first · No telemetry · No cloud calls · No source upload

Requirements

  • Node.js 18+ installed
  • TCalc CLI built (git clone + pnpm build from the repo, or a pre-built wma binary)

Quick Start

  1. Open Settings → Tools → TCalc
  2. Set the path to your wma CLI binary (e.g., /path/to/tcalc/apps/cli/dist/index.js)
  3. Set the Node.js executable path
  4. Open the TCalc tool window (View → Tool Windows → TCalc)
  5. Click Scan Workspace
